body:
# [Discord](https://discord.gg/Xw86rqWWcW)

**"Level = Size" adds that the player's size depends on their level.**

**This plugin works well as a challenge and makes the game a bit more special.**

### How it works:

The principle is relatively simple: the higher the level, the larger the player.

```
Level * 0.1 + 0.5 = Size
```

**If you have any ideas, improvements or feedback, feel free to tell us about them on our Discord server.**
